abstract: Universal /scaffold-hooks skill: the single hooks scaffolder for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Devin CLI, and OpenCode. Bundles each harness as a self-contained component under harnesses/<name>/, detects existing hook surfaces for conservative bare refreshes, writes a shared repo-owned hooks/ ports-and-adapters layout, migrates old generated hook roots, preserves custom hooks, and verifies that final harness configs no longer collide.
